name: Minecraft
description: An open-ended sandbox game built around exploration, building, crafting and optional survival or multiplayer play, with accessibility settings across current Minecraft products.
intended_use: For players who want open-ended building and exploration with a choice of game modes and configurable accessibility settings.
audience_or_context: A broad-audience game rather than an ND-specific product. Its open-ended structure may be relevant when browsing by preferred play style rather than diagnosis.
limitations: Survival, combat, multiplayer, sound and visual effects can add time pressure, sensory load or social demands.
Features and accessibility settings differ by edition, platform and version.
cost_or_access_notes: Minecraft is commercial software; price, included editions and platform availability vary.
conflicts_of_interest: The official Minecraft site is a first-party source for product and accessibility information and has a commercial interest in the game.

provenance.method: Official game and accessibility information checked on 2026-08-28. Listing records play characteristics and access without inferring therapeutic or neurodivergence-specific benefit.
